description: For generic plant shapes, the species that fit them — after the designer has signed off the shape layout, instead of searching the catalog shape by shape. Same habit as the shape, mature size within a tolerance of the shape's, suited to the place's light, soil and hardiness; species the shape's label or notes name come first (named). Like shapes (same form, label without its number, size) share one entry with their ids; each candidate is one line. Shapes no species fits come under `noFit`: tell the designer before the swap.

ids.description: Shape ids (default: every shape in the design)

light.description: The place's light (default: read from each shape's notes)

soil.description: The place's soil, as get_plant_attributes words it

name: suggest_species
